overall_summary: Deduplication and recency weighting reveal that space-related 'What If' scenarios and extreme planetary facts (published late September to early October 2026) are dramatically outperforming older general science and psychology shorts. Videos like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year', 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?', and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' are generating high views-per-day and superior likes-per-view ratios compared to early September uploads. Content featuring speculative physics, extreme cosmic environments, and visceral planetary hazards yields the strongest audience retention and engagement signals.
